arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: the side that brought the case argues Section 1101(a)(43) includes state and foreign law violations.
The government argues Congress chose to make only federal arson an aggravated felony.
The government notes the federal arson statute carries a minimum five-year sentence.
Justice Alito questioned the statutory language describing the state offense in federal terms.

The government argues Congress specifically chose to limit aggravated felonies to federal arson statutes.
